scripts.setup:local: pnpm --filter @munim/contracts build && pnpm db:push && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm voice:download
scripts.dev:all: pnpm --filter @munim/contracts build && concurrently --kill-others -n api,web,voice "pnpm --filter @munim/api dev" "pnpm --filter @munim/web dev" "pnpm voice:dev"
scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @munim/contracts build && concurrently --kill-others -n api,web -c cyan,green "pnpm --filter @munim/api dev" "pnpm --filter @munim/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @munim/contracts build && pnpm --filter @munim/api build && pnpm --filter @munim/voice build && pnpm --filter @munim/web build
